opticalTimingConventions.authority: Current d1218 zh/en prose[9,12,13,14], with unaffected d1219-approved text retained.
opticalTimingConventions.restFrame: K1: stationary A emits, stationary B reflects, stationary A receives. tau0 is the round trip on the rod clock; c tau0 = 2 l0. Fig224 contains no tau1/tau2 or false proper-time dial.
opticalTimingConventions.movingFrame: K: tau1 outbound A at emission to B1 at reflection; tau2 return B1 at reflection to A2 at reception. tau1 and tau2 are consecutive K-coordinate intervals, not independent proper times.
opticalTimingConventions.outbound: A_x=270, B1_x=510: path 240 = l(180) + shift1(60), labelled l+v tau1. v tau1=60; c/v=240/60=4.
opticalTimingConventions.return: B1_x=510, A2_x=366: path 144 = l(180) - shift2(36), labelled l-v tau2. v tau2=36; c/v=144/36=4.
opticalTimingConventions.equality: tau1=l/(c-v), tau2=l/(c+v); construction ratio tau1/tau2=60/36=5/3 equals (c+v)/(c-v) for construction v/c=1/4. These are unprinted layout units, not new givens.
opticalTimingConventions.total: tau=tau1+tau2; tau0=tau/gamma belongs to the rod-rest clock, not to the separated equal-t K clocks in fig223.
opticalTimingConventions.directedCues: Added upper c cue points right and lower c cue left; original double-ended dimension arrows remain dimensions.
opticalTimingConventions.sourceErratum: Current corrected l-v tau2 is used; this review does not re-open source pages or re-adjudicate the registered p0261 source erratum.
